episodes.title: Atmen
episodes.summary: After taking mindfulness lessons, defense lawyer Björn finds a new way to deal with his main client: a violent crime boss who demands too much of him.

episodes.title: Glück
episodes.summary: Björn figures out how to mindfully dispose of a body while navigating the suspicions of his family, the police and Dragan's underlings.

episodes.title: Angst
episodes.summary: As he gets back to his routine to avoid any appearance of guilt, Björn discovers a couple of loose ends he needs to deal with.

episodes.title: Unverschämtheiten
episodes.summary: Katharina asks for Björn's help in securing a day care center for Emily. Toni suspects Björn isn't being truthful about Dragan's whereabouts.

episodes.title: Panik
episodes.summary: Nicole investigates a series of explosive clues. After being kidnapped by a rival crime boss, Björn sets out to expose Toni's plan.

episodes.title: Brainstorming
episodes.summary: It would be easier to just murder everyone, but Björn decides on a more practical solution. Nicole questions Emily about her trip to the lake.

episodes.title: Wut
episodes.summary: Caught between Toni and the police, Björn looks for a way to kill two birds with one stone. Boris makes a final demand to see Dragan.

episodes.title: Tod
episodes.summary: Björn enacts a risky plan to deal with Boris and get Nicole off his back, and it's important to be mindful of every detail.

episodes.title: Urlaub
episodes.summary: Nicole runs into trouble with her evidence. On a family vacation in Austria, Björn tries to relax — but one serious slip shows he still has work to do.

episodes.title: Realität
episodes.summary: Björn stages a day care break-in to deal with yet another problem. A chilling message and a surprise visit from the parents' group complicate things.

episodes.title: Eltern
episodes.summary: The parents' group pushes to inspect the basement. Disturbed in his sleep, Björn's inner child nudges him to deal with the teens across the street.

episodes.title: Kreativität
episodes.summary: Björn agrees to meet with Laura's brother Kurt. As the blackmail escalates, his creative plan for the Holgerson hostages takes a dark turn.

episodes.title: Wissen
episodes.summary: When Björn learns about Kurt's past, he grows suspicious. With Kurt, Nicole, pushy parents and a tricky delivery, he's got a lot on his mind.

episodes.title: Fehler
episodes.summary: Nicole shows interest in Kurt and questions the "coincidences" in the Holgerson story. Meanwhile, Björn comes up with yet another explosive plan.

episodes.title: Zweifel
episodes.summary: Björn enjoys a false sense of security, but the Holgersons come knocking and he makes a risky promise. Sascha plots to keep the parents in check.

episodes.title: Moral
episodes.summary: Björn makes Kurt an offer he can't refuse... or can he? As things get ugly in the basement, staying calm is Björn's last defense against chaos.
